title: Two formulations of the stalk comparison of cohomology over strict henselisations and a separably closed field
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that two natural formulations of the stalk comparison over the strict henselisations are equivalent (statement lines 16531-16548). The proof (proof lines 16550-16579) is a limit computation: separably closedness of K presents the relevant base change as a cofiltered limit of disjoint unions of copies of Spec(K), the compared fibre product is rewritten as the limit of the local fibre products, and the colimit theorem for cohomology of such limits finishes. H2: one limit presentation and one application of the colimit theorem.
